Nina bantu, thobelani iNkosi yenu, ngokuba ukuzamazama ngeSikhathi [sokwahlela] into enzima impela.
Mhla lapho niyobona umame oncelisayo ekhohlwa [uswana] aluncelisayo nozethwele uyozalela khona lapho. Futhi uyobona abantu engathi badakiwe kulapho bengadakiwe kepha isijeziso sika Allah sinzima.
Futhi kunalabo bantu abaphikisa ngo Allah bengenalwazi futhi ebe elandela wonke uShayitane oyihlongandlebe.
Unqunyelwe ukuthi lowo oyomlandela, uzomdukisa aphinde amholele esijezisweni somlilo.

Nina bantu, uma ninokungabaza ngokuvuswa [kwelizayo emuva kokofa]; bhekani ngoba sanidala ngobumba kwaba yisidoda kwaba ihlulu kwaba umbungu ophelele nongaphelele ukuze sinicacisele; futhi sigcina esikuthandayo ezibelethweni kuze kufike isikhathi esibekiwe; bese sinikhipha niyizingane, bese niyakhula nibe badala. Phakathi kwenu kunalabo abafayo [besebasha] kuthi abanye baze baguge baphenduke izintothoviyane ezingasazi lutho. Futhi uzobona umhlaba womile, kuthi lapho sesehlisele amanzi [emvula] kuwo uvele uqhakaze wande uphinde ukhiqhize lonke uhlobo oluhle lwezitshalo.
Lokho ngungenxa yokuthi u Allah uyiQiniso nokuthi nguYena ovusa abafileyo nongehlulwa yilutho.
Nokuthi iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] siyeza, akunakungabaza ngaso; nanokuthi u Allah uyobavusa labo abasemathuneni.
Phakathi kwabantu kunalowo ophikisana ngo Allah engenalwazi noma incazelo noma incwadi ecacisayo.
Uvele abheke le [ezigqaja], ukuze adukise [abantu] endleleni ka Allah [i-isilamu]. Uyothola ukuhlazeka lapha emhlabeni, kuthi ngoSuku lokwahlulela simzwise isijeziso somlilo.
Lokho, kungenxa yemisebenzi yezandla zakho nokuthi u Allah akasoze enze okungebulungiswa esigqileni.

Phakathi kwabantu, kunalowo okhonza u Allah enongabazane. Uma kumhambela kahle uyaqhubeka [ngokukhonza u Allah]. Kepha uma ehlelwa ubunzima uyajika [abe yimbuka]; akazuzanga lutho emhlabeni nakwelizayo. Lokho ukulahlekelwa okusobala.
Ukhonza ngaphandle kuka Allah lokho okungeke kwamlimaza [uma engakulaleli] futhi okungeke kwamzuzisa [uma ekulalela]. Lokho ukuduka okujulile.
Ukhonza lowo ubungozi bakhe buseduze kunosizo kwakhe. Waze wamubi umsizi nomhlanganyeli bo.
Nebala labo abakholwayo abenza nezenzo ezinhle u Allah uyobangenisa ezivandeni okugeleza ezansikwazo imifula. Impela u Allah wenza akufunayo.
Lowo ocabanga ukuthi u Allah akasoze amsiza [uMuhammadi] emhlabeni nakwelizayo; makabophele intambo ophahleni azikhunge ngalo bese ebheka-ke ukuthi lomzamo wakhe uyoyiqeda yini lenzondo anayo na?
Futhi sayembulela kanjalo [iKurani] iyimibiko ecacile nokuthi u Allah uhola amfunayo.

Impela labo abakholwayo, nalabo abangamaJuda, namaNasarina namaSabiya kanye noMajusi nalabo ababhangqayo; u Allah uyokwahlulela phakathi kwabo ngoSuku lokuKwahlulela. Phela u Allah uyiqhaphe yonke into impela.

Awuboni yini ukuthi bonke abasemazulwini nasemhlabeni kanye nelanga nenyanga nezinkanyezi nezintaba nezihlahla nezilwane neningi labantu, konke kuwa ngobuso kukhothamela u Allah. Kanti futhi baningi abafanelwe isijeziso. Futhi lowo u Allah amhlazile akekho oyombuyisa isithunzi. Impela u Allah wenza akufunayo.
Laba ababili abaphikisanayo baphikisana ngeNkosi yabo. Labo abangakholwa bayosikelwa izembatho emlilweni, bathelwe ngamanzi ashisayo ekhanda.
Kuyoncibikaliswa ngawo lokho okuseziswini zabo kanjalo nezikhumba.
Futhi [bayoshaywa] ngezando zensimbi.
Kuyothi njalo uma befuna ukuphuma kuwo [umlilo] ngenxa yosizi; bayobuyiselwa kuwo [kuthiwe]: “Yizwani-ke isijeziso somlilo”.

Labo abakholwayo benze nezenzo ezinhle, impela u Allah uyobafaka ezivandeni okugeleza enzansi kwazo imifula, bayohlotshiswa kuzo ngeziqhizo zegolide nangamalulu, futhi izembatho zabo kuzo kuyoba isilika [emnene].
Futhi bayoholelwa emazwini amahle baphinde baholelwe endleleni encomekayo [i-Isilamu].

Impela labo abangakholwa nabayisihibe endleleni ka Allah naseMasijidiHaramu, lena esayenzela isintu ngokulinganayo, kungaba ozonzile kuyo noma oyisihambi. Futhi lowo ohlosa ukwenza kuyo [iMasijidiHaramu] impambuko ngokungebulungiswa siyomzwisa isijeziso esibuhlungu.

Khumbula futhi mhla sikhombisa u Ibhirahimu indawo yeNdlu [iKaba], [sathi kuye]: “Ungabhangqi lutho naMi. Futhi uhlanze iNdlu yami, [uyihlanzele] labo abayizungezayo nalabo abathandazayo [bemile, bekhotheme bewa nangobuso].
Memezela ngeHaji kusintu sonkana. Bayoza kuwe ngezinyawo nangamakameli bewagibele; beza ngazo zonke izindlela eziqhamuka ekudeni.

Ukuze bazibonele lokho okuyinsizakalo kubo baphinde babalule igama lika Allah ezinsukwini ezaziwayo ngalokho ababele kona ezilwaneni zemfuyo [ezizohlatshwa]. Ngakhoke, dlanini kuzo niphe nalowo abaphuyile [abadla imbuya ngothi].
Bese beqedelela ukususa izinsila zabo [ngokuqeda zonke izinkambiso ezisele], bagcine nezibopho zabo bese benza iTawafu [ukuzungeza] yeNdlu ekhululiwe [iKaba].

Lokho, nalowo ohlonipha izinkambiso zika Allah ezihloniphekile, yikona okongcono kuye eNkosini yakhe. Futhi nivunyelwe izilwane ezidliwayo ngaphandle kwalezi enilandiswe ngaso. Ngakhoke ziqhelelaniseni nokungcola kwezithixo niphinde niziqhelelanise namanga.
Nibe msulwa ku Allah ningambhangqi nalutho. Futhi lowo obhangqa u Allah, kungathi uwe emkhathini wahlwithwa yinyoni noma wahamba nomoya wamusa endaweni esekudeni.
Lokho, nalowo ohlonipha Izimpawu zika Allah, impela kusuka ekuthobeni kwezinhliziyo.
Ninezinsizakalo kuzo [izilwane zomhlatshelo] kuze kufike isikhathi esibekiwe emuva kwalokho ziyohlatshwa eNdlini ekhululiwe.

Futhi zonke izizwe [zabakholwayo zaphambilini] sababekela izinkambiso [zokuhlaba] ukuze babalule igama lika Allah kulokho ababele kona ezilwaneni ezidliwayo. Belu okumele nimkhonze uyedwa vo, ngakhoke zinikeleni kuYe. Futhi thula izindaba ezimnandi kulabo abazithobayo.
Laba okuthi uma kuphathwa igama lika Allah, izinhliziyo zabo zigcwala ukwesaba futhi banga babekezelayo kulokho okubehlelayo baphinde benze neswala nakulokho esibabele kona bayanikela.

Amakameli anonile nawo siwenze aba ezinye zezimpawu zika Allah, ninokuhle kuzo. Ngakhoke phimisani igama lika Allah kuwo lapho limile [nilihlaba]. Uma seliwile ngohlangothi, dlanini kuwo niphe ohluphekayo ongaceli nocelayo. Sinijubele wona kanjalo ukuze nibonge.

Inyama yawo ayisoze yafika ku Allah kanjalo negazi lawo kepha iTakuwa [ukuthobela intando ka Allah nokuzinikela kuYe] evela kini efika kuye. Unijubele wona kanjalo ukuze niqhakambise ubukhulu buka Allah ngalokho aniholele kukho. Futhi yethula izindaba ezinhle kulabo abenza okuhle.
Impela u Allah uyabavikela labo abakholwayo; ngokuba u Allah akamthandi impela wonke lowo oyiqili ongabongi.
Labo abahlaselwa ngokungebulungiswa bavunyelwe [ukuba baziphindiselele], futhi impela u Allah unamandla okubasiza [abakholwayo bengalwanga].

Labo abakhishwa emizini yabo ngokungemthetho, ngenxa nje yokuthi bathi: “u Allah iNkosi yethu”. Ukube u Allah akavikelanga abanye abantu ngabanye, ngabe kade abhindlizwa amaTempeli nama Sonto nama Sinagogi nama Masijidi okuphathwa igama lika Allah kakhukulu. Futhi u Allah nakanjani uyomsiza lowo omsizayo [ngokuvikela intando]. Impela u Allah Ungumninimandla onguSomandla.
Labo uma sibamisa emhlabeni baqikelele ukwenza iswala bakhiphe nezakati bagqugquzele okuhle banqande okubi. Futhi isiphetho zezinto [zonke] ngesika Allah.
Uma bekuphika, kanjalo nalabo ababandulelayo baphika; isizwe sikaNuhu no Adi kanye noTamudi.
Nesizwe sika Ibhirahimu nesika Luti.
Nabantu base Madiyana. No Musa waphikwa; ngabayeka okwesikhashana laba abangakholwa ngase ngibajezisa. Bheka nje ukuthi saba njani isijeziso saMi.
Ziningi izizwe esazibhubhisa mhla ziphambuka; zawa bhu phansi nophahla lwazo. Futhi miningi nemithombo eyekelelwe nezinqaba eziphakeme.
Ingabe abahambanga yini ezweni babe nezinhliziyo abaqonda ngazo noma izindlebe abezwa ngazo. Empeleni, akuwona amehlo angaboni, kepha yizinhliziyo lezi ezisezifubeni okuzona ezingaboni.
Futhi bakujaha ngesijeziso; bheka ngoba u Allah akasoze asiphula isethembiso saKhe. Futhi usuku olulodwa eNkosini yakho lulingana neninyaka eyinkulungwane kulokhu enikubalayo.
Futhi ziningi izizwe esazipha isikhathi nakuba zaziphambukile. Sabe sesizijezisa belu isiphetho sikiMi.
Yithi: “Sintu, impela ngingumexwayisi ocacile kini”.
Ngakhoke, labo abakholwayo baphinde benze okulungileyo, bayothola intethelelo nesondlo esihle.
Kuthi labo abazikhandla ukuphikisana nemibiko yeThu, yibona kanye abayongena emlilweni.

Futhi yileso naleso Sithunywa noMembulelwa [uMphorofeti] esamthumela ngaphambilini kwakho [Muhamadi]; kwakhuthi lapho uma efunda, uShayitani azame ukwengeza ekufundeni kwaso. Kepha u Allah uyakwesula lokho okwengezwa uShayitane bese ehlunga ngobuchule imibiko yaKhe. U Allah Unolwazi Ukhaliphile.
Ukuze enze lokho okwengezwe uShayitani kube isivivinyo kulabo abanokufa [ukuzenzisa] ezinhliziyweni zabo nalabo ozinhliziyo zabo zilukhuni.

Nokuthi labo abaphiwe ulwazi bazi ukuthi iyiqiniso [iKurani] elivela eNkosini yakho, ukuze bakholwe yiyo nezinhliziyo zabo ziyithobele. Impela u Allah unguMholeli walabo abakholwayo endleleni eqondile.
Futhi labo abangakholwa bayohlala beyingabaza kuze kube mhla kufika iSikhathi bengazelele noma bafikelwe isijeziso soSuku olomile [uSuku lokwahlulela].
Bonke ubukhosi ngalolo Suku bungobuka Allah, uyokwahlulela phakathi kwabo. Ngakhoke, labo abakholwayo baphinde benze okulungileyo bayongena ezivandeni zengcebeleko.
Kuthi labo abangakholwa baphinde bathatha imibiko yeThu njengamanga, labo, yibona kanye abathola isijeziso esithunazayo.
Futhi labo abafudukela endleleni ka Allah bese bebulawa noma bazifele, u Allah uyobondla ngesondlo esihle. Impela u Allah unguMondli ongcono.
Uyobangenisa endaweni abayoyithakasela. Impela u Allah Unolwazi Unesineke.
Lokho; lowo ophindisela ngokulingene lokho ahlukunyezwe ngakho kepha bese ehlukunyezwa ngokungemthetho, u Allah uyomsiza nakanjani. Impela u Allah Umnene Ungumthetheleli.
Lokho, yingoba u Allah ufaka ubusuku emini afake imini ebusuku nokuthi impela u Allah Ungozwayo Obonayo.
Lokho; yingoba u Allah nguYena Oyiqiniso kanti lokhu abakukhonzayo ngaphandle kwaKhe kuwumbhedo, nokuthi u Allah nguYena Ophakeme Omkhulu.
Awuboni yini ukuthi u Allah wehlisa amazi emvula bese umhlaba uguquke ube luhlaza. Impela u Allah Ungonakayo Onolwazi.
Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kungokwaKhe. Belu impela u Allah Ungozimele Odunyiswayo.

Awuboni yini ukuthi u Allah unijubele konke okusemhlabeni kanjalo nomkhumbi ohamba olwandle ngomyalelo waKhe. Futhi ubambe isibhakabhaka ukuba singaweli phezu komhlaba, ngaphandleke uma ekuvumela [lokho]. Impela u Allah Unobubele Unesihe kusintu.
Futhi nguYena onipha ukuphila aphinde akuthathe aphinde anivuse. Impela umuntu akakholwa.
Isizwe nesizwe sisibekele inkambiso abahambisa ngayo. Ngakhoke mabangaqophisani nawe kuloludaba. Futhi memela eNkosini yakho; impela usekukhanyeni okuqondile.
Kepha uma bephikisana nawe, yithi: “u Allah ukwazi kahle lokho enikwenzayo”.
U Allah uyokwehlulela phakathi kwenu ngoSuku lokwahlulela kulokho eniphikisana ngakho.
Awazi yini ukuthi u Allah wazi konke okusezulwini nasemhlabeni. Impela lokho kulotshiwe [oqwembeni olulondiwe]. Impela lokho kuwubala ku Allah.
Futhi bakhonza ngaphandle kuka Allah lokho okungenabufakazi ngakho nalokho abangenalwazi ngakho. Futhi labo abaphambukile akekho oyobahlenga.

Uma befundelwa imibiko yeThu ecacile, ubona ukunyukubala ebusweni balabo abangakholwa. Kusala nje kancane ukuba babagxavule labo ababafundela imibiko yeThu. Yithi: “Kunganjani nginazise ngokubi kakhulu kunalokho na? Umlilo u Allah awuthembise labo abangakholwa, futhi saze sasibi isiphetho”.

Nina bantu, kwenziwe umzekelo ngakhoke wulaleleni. Impela labo enibakhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah abasoze badala ngisho impukane noma bengayihlanganela. Futhi uma impukane ibahlwitha utho abasoze bakhona ukuyiphuca kona. Akanamandla umthungathi [izikhonzwa] nothungathwayo [impukane].
Abamhloniphanga u Allah ngendlela efanele Yena. Impela u Allah Ungonamandla OnguSomandla.
U Allah uqoke izithunywa ezingelosini nasebantwini. Impela u Allah Ungozwayo Obonayo.
Ukwazi konke okungaphambi kwabo [okwendlula] nokusemuva kwabo [ikusasa]. Futhi zonke izinto ziyobuyela ku Allah.
Nina enikholwayo khothamani futhi niwe ngobuso nikhonze iNkosi yenu nenze okuhle ukuze niphumelele.

Futhi zikhandleni ku Allah, ukuzikhandla okufanele Yena. NguYena oniqokile futhi akanenzelanga ubunzima enkolweni; okuyinkolo kababa wenu u Ibhirahimu. NguYena oniqambe ukuthi ningamaMusilimu ngaphambilini [eZincwadini] nakulokhu [kwiKurani]. [Uniqokile] ukuze iSithunywa sibe ufakazi ngani, nani nibe ngofakazi ngesintu sonkana. Ngakhoke qikelelani ukwenza iswala nikhiphe nezakati nibambelele ku Allah, ngokuba nguYena uMhlengi wenu; yeka uMhlengi omuhle noMsekeli omuhle.
